name: Endorsely
description: Endorsely is the FIRST AI-powered affiliate marketing platform for SaaS companies that finds perfect-fit affiliates for you. It tracks which partners send high-quality customers (not just traffic) & handles all payments automatically. Free until $1K MRR.
label: Free SaaS Affiliate Software that Finds You Affiliates
label_zh: 免费的SaaS联盟软件，帮您找到联盟伙伴
content_zh: Endorsely 是首个为 SaaS 公司打造的 AI 驱动的联盟营销平台，能够为你找到最适合的合作伙伴。它不仅能追踪哪些合作伙伴带来了高质量客户（而不仅仅是流量），还能自动处理所有付款事宜。在月经常性收入达到 1000 美元之前，该服务是免费的。

name: Visionstory - AI Presentation
description: Drop in a slide deck—Visionstory auto‑writes slide‑by‑slide scripts and delivers them through a lifelike digital presenter. Pick from built‑in avatars or upload yours. No editing, just instant, affordable, dynamic video.
label: Transform slides into engaging, AI‑hosted video stories
label_zh: 将幻灯片转换为引人入胜的AI主持视频故事
content_zh: 上传一份幻灯片——Visionstory 会自动为每一页幻灯片撰写脚本，并通过逼真的数字主持人进行展示。你可以选择内置的虚拟形象，也可以上传自己的。无需编辑，即可快速生成价格合理的动态视频。

name: Finseo.ai
description: Monitor your visibility across AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Claude & Gemini. See daily mentions of your brand, domain, and compare with competitors. Every prompt is tracked—stay ahead in the age of generative search.
label: Track your visibility in chatgpt, perplexity, gemini & more
label_zh: 跟踪您在ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini等平台上的可见度
content_zh: 监控你在ChatGPT、Perplexity、DeepSeek、Claude和Gemini等AI引擎中的可见度。查看每天提及你的品牌和域名的情况，并与竞争对手进行比较。每个提示都会被跟踪——在生成式搜索时代保持领先。

name: Codex by ChatGPT
description: A cloud-based software agent, Codex handles tasks like writing features, fixing bugs, answering code questions, and proposing pull requests—each in a separate sandboxed environment preloaded with your repo.
label: Cloud agent for parallel dev tasks, powered by Codex-1
label_zh:
云代理用于并行开发任务，由 Codex-1 驱动

云代理助力并行开发任务，由 Codex-1 强力驱动
content_zh: Codex by ChatGPT 是一个基于云端的软件代理，可以处理诸如编写功能、修复错误、回答代码问题和提出拉取请求等任务。每个任务都在预加载了你代码仓库的独立沙箱环境中进行。

name: Samurai+
description: Unlock 100+ premium Webflow and Framer templates with Samurai+, the first subscription-based platform for designers and developers. Get lifetime access, Figma files, and monthly updates today.
label: 1st Sub-Based Platform for Webflow + Framer Templates
label_zh: 首个基于订阅的Webflow + Framer模板平台
content_zh: 通过Samurai+，解锁100多个高级Webflow和Framer模板。这是首个面向设计师和开发者的订阅平台，提供终身访问权限、Figma文件以及每月更新。

name: Windsurf Wave 9
description: Introducing our new family of models: SWE-1, SWE-1-lite, and SWE-1-mini. Based on internal evals, it has performance nearing that of frontier models from the foundation labs.
label: Our frontier models built for engineering, not just code
label_zh: 我们的前沿模型专为工程设计，而不仅仅是代码
content_zh: 我们推出了新的模型系列：SWE-1、SWE-1-lite 和 SWE-1-mini。根据内部评估，这些模型的性能接近基础实验室的前沿模型。

name: Velocity: Prompt Assistant
description:
AI can’t help you if your prompt sucks
Velocity rewrites & enhances your prompts in one click on: ChatGPT, Gemini, Bolt, Lovable, etc, with context.

It refines prompts in real-time to save time, tokens & unlocks precise results. Without any expertise needed!
label: Prompt like an expert across any AI tool, in one click
label_zh: 像专家一样一键在任何AI工具中进行提示
topics_zh: 浏览器扩展，人工智能，生产力
content_zh:
如果你的提示词写得不好，AI 也帮不了你。Velocity: Prompt Assistant 可以一键帮你重写和优化提示词，适用于 ChatGPT、Gemini、Bolt、Lovable 等平台，并且能根据上下文进行调整。

它能实时优化提示词，节省时间和计算资源，同时获得更准确的结果。无需任何专业知识！

name: Notato
description: Notato turns any lecture, meeting or article into crisp, structured notes. Record or import audio, video or web links and instantly get transcripts, summaries, flashcards, quizzes and chat-Q&A — all on your iPhone.
label: Leave your next lecture or meeting with beautiful notes.
label_zh: 让你的下一次讲座或会议留下漂亮的笔记。
content_zh: Notato 可以将任何讲座、会议或文章转化为简洁、结构化的笔记。你可以录制或导入音频、视频或网页链接，立即获取文字记录、摘要、闪卡、测验和聊天问答——所有这些功能都可以在你的 iPhone 上实现。

name: Hey, Copilot!
description: Microsoft's 'Hey, Copilot!' lets Windows Insiders invoke Copilot Voice hands-free. This opt-in feature uses on-device wake word detection. Rolling out now for English language users in Insider channels.
label: Hands-free Copilot access on your PC
content_zh: 微软的“Hey, Copilot!”功能让Windows Insider用户可以免提调用Copilot Voice。这项可选功能利用了设备上的唤醒词检测技术。目前该功能正在向使用英语的Insider通道用户推出。

name: GameBoy vibes
description: Play GameBoy games with a CANDYCAT-themed emulator
label: a Candycat themed GameBoy Emulator in the browser
label_zh: 一个以Candycat为主题的浏览器游戏机模拟器
content_zh: 用CANDYCAT主题的模拟器玩GameBoy游戏

name: Thryve Wellness
description: Thryve: Apple Health insights go deeper. Unlock YOUR Optimal Workout Zones, unique Time-Lag Correlations & Transparent Wellness Scores. Personalized analysis, 100% private on-device. Stop guessing, start optimizing! Try free.
label: Unlock deep Apple health insights
label_zh: 解锁深度苹果健康洞察
content_zh: Thryve Wellness：深入分析Apple Health数据。解锁您的最佳锻炼区间、独特的时间滞后相关性及透明的健康评分。个性化分析，100%在设备上私密进行。告别猜测，开始优化！免费试用。

name: Enhancor
description: Transform AI-generated skin textures into photorealistic results with Enhancor. The ultimate tool for creating indistinguishable human skin textures using advanced AI technology.
label: AI-Powered Skin Texture Enhancement Tool
label_zh: AI驱动的皮肤质感增强工具
content_zh: 使用Enhancor，将AI生成的皮肤纹理转化为逼真的效果。这款工具利用先进的AI技术，创造出几乎无法区分的人类皮肤纹理。

name: HanaVerse
description: HanaVerse, an open-source self-hosted web UI that transforms Ollama language models into an interactive experience with Hana, a 2D anime character who not only visually reacts to your conversations but also speaks responses through text-to-speech.
label: Talking anime character WebUI for Ollama
label_zh: 会说话的动漫角色 WebUI 适用于 Ollama
content_zh: HanaVerse 是一个开源的自托管网页界面，它将Ollama语言模型转变为与2D动漫角色Hana互动的体验。Hana不仅会通过视觉效果对你的对话做出反应，还会通过文本转语音功能说出回应。

name: Mnemonic Finder
description: Mnemonic Finder helps you learn new words faster by searching their mnemonic meanings. Instantly open the mnemonic result in MnemonicDictionary.com
label: Instantly search for mnemonic meanings of words via click
label_zh:
直译：
立即通过点击搜索单词的记忆法含义

意译（保持原有格式）：
一键搜索单词的记忆技巧
content_zh: Mnemonic Finder 通过搜索助记词的意思帮助你更快地学习新单词。你可以立即在 MnemonicDictionary.com 上查看助记结果。

name: Remindlio
description: Automate your appointment confirmations with WhatsApp. Reduce no-shows by up to 80% with our automated WhatsApp reminder system. Perfect for medical practices, salons, and service businesses.
label: Whatsapp appointment confirmation system
content_zh: 通过WhatsApp自动发送预约确认信息。我们的自动化WhatsApp提醒系统可以将爽约率降低高达80%。适用于医疗机构、美容院和服务型企业。
